notes.title: Holiday patch in the making!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25177104/135fad6094c42c7b40d70a6161ae6213bf71673d.png[/img]

Hey all!

We're aware of some issues with save and load, and are working on a good patch on that. If you have heavy time invested in a piece, we for now recommend doing an extra export before saving, also recommend saving to use "save as" to have a few revision files to avoid loss of work.

This stability patch will be the first one on offer, while the patch following that will contain more updates to interface and tool feel.

notes.title: Another big update on stability and user experience
notes.content:
The changes in this update are too numerous to mention in full, but for an overview:
[list]
[*] Fixed some of the most problematic errors relating to undo and multiobject
[*] Simplified menu interaction further, adding options like grab button and "tractor beam" interactions
[*] Upgrades to desktop interface
[*] Fixed some more import, load and save bugs
[*] Improved precision on indicators
[/list]

Kodon is ALWAYS open to input and feedback! Join us at [url=https://discord.com/invite/Esr5wgkGvA]Discord[/url] and tell it to our face what we should change!

notes.title: New Alpha Out
notes.content:
We're not done yet, but our most stable and optimized Kodon Alpha yet is out on the Alpha branch (see instructions below.

We really hope you can test it out for us. There may be some PCs where it runs slower than the main branch, and some PCs where it crashes, we really want to know so we can fix it for you.

In short, the highlighted improvements of this update are first and foremost framerate upgrades. Please give us feedback here or on Discord!

[list]
[*] Greatly improved Desktop and VR Performance
[*] Greatly improved idle usage / background performance
[*] Edit lockup and tutorial lockup bugfixes
[*] Improved VR+Desktop integration
[*] Desktop controls improved
[*] Index controllers improved
[/list]

Known major bugs:
[list]
[*] Multiobject switching can go wrong
[*] Undo is unstable
[*] Memory limitations exceeding can cause crashes
[*] Vive support is still broken
[*] And more
[/list]

How to switch branches:

notes.title: Major update before V1.0 Release
notes.content:
We would like to announce that we are on the homestretch of releasing KODON in its full glory. 
Working hard days and nights to present you with “The New Way of Sculpting”, our v1.0 is just around the corner. In the meantime, you now have a chance to get  KODON at a significantly discounted early access price.

This version is our biggest upgrade yet!

notes.title: Kodon out of Early Access
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]
It's official, Kodon V1.0 will be out of Early Access on [b]December 17th 2021. [/b]

With your help and feedback we have arrived to a point in development where we believe Kodon's sculpting tools are ready for release. 
We have worked really hard and so here's what you can expect for V1.0 on December 17th:
[list]
[*] Stability
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Better UI/UX
[*] No more conversion issues
[*] GPU based voxels 
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]As you can see, Model room is not included in the changes planned for Kodon V1.0 2021. It will still be available for all users to keep testing but it will not be on the same level of development as the sculpting tools. 
Model room's turn in development comes on 2022, where we plan on improving the overall functionality and experience. 

If you haven't acquired Kodon yet, this is the time to add it to your wishlist since there will be a release discount running!
Development of Kodon will continue after release with more important and fun features to be added along 2022. Please look forward to it and be a part of the Kodon journey!

notes.title: Kitbash library and recovery file
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

Here is the promised update from last week! These are the most important changes that you will find:
[list]
[*] We have added the kitbash library. You should be able to find it on the polybrush option in Sculpt mode. This library is unfortunately not available in the Volume room yet, but we will let you know when that is the case. 
[*] Kodon can now detect whether it crashed the last session, and prompt the user for a recovery file when restarting the program.
[*] General tablet support, especially for non Wacom tablets. Please give this one a try, we would really like to know how this behaves with your setup.
[*] Fixed a memory leak (Sculpt room).
[*] Smaller delay post stroke on big models (Sculpt room).
[*] Faster .kob and .kop load and save. 
[*] Save for correct multiresolution levels.
[/list] Please give these changes a try and let us know how they're working for you by sending any feedback and issues you may have to support@tenklabs.com and we will try to resolve them together with your help.

I also want to thank you all that have taken the time to answer [url=https://www.survio.com/survey/d/M0P6Y2K9H9P4Q0M3U]our survey.[/url] It's extremely helpful for us! Please, if you haven't responded to the survey and you have 10-15 minutes to spare, it would be awesome to have your input! 

If you haven't checked it out yet, we have begun writing documentation about Kodon. We will continue to update it and you can find it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2592426660]here.[/url]

And lastly, like I mentioned last week, we are going into a heavy period of development, where we will aim to deliver the next improvements: 
[list]
[*] UI/UX changes
[*] Remesh fix
[*] Conversion issues fix
[/list]
Thanks so much for always supporting Kodon and the team! 
Brianda <3

[b]PSA: if you find any problems, please downgrade by right clicking on Kodon's name in your Steam library, then choose properties -> betas -> previous_version. [/b]

notes.title: Major Kodon update: GPU based tools and Multiresolution
notes.content:
[b]Hi there Kodon enthusiasts![/b] 

Like mentioned on the title, we have changed the way Kodon fundamentally works, trying to make a significant improvement on performance by utilizing the power of the GPU. 
The sculpting process now takes place here! 

Here's what you can expect in regards to changes:
[list]
[*] Multiresolution
[*] GPU Accelerated sculpting tools (Tool speed is ALOT faster, this is the biggest improvement)
[*] Brush Feel Greatly improved (Our second biggest improvement)
[*] Improved Lighting
[*] FBX, OBJ Import export improvements (vertex color)
[*] Insert Mesh brush (Great for concepting)
[*] UI improvements, including object naming (another update with bigger changes here is expected to be ready very soon)
[/list]
This update has unfortunately still some issues in the following criteria:
[list]
[*] Remesh
[*] Conversion
[*] Symmetry
[*] Multiresolution
[*] Model Room is mostly unchanged: no changes on UI or bugs in this room.
[/list]
[b]Cloth Sim is currently unavailable[/b] in this update as we restructure Kodon and we hope to fix these issues in following builds, however, if you opt into the [b]previous_version[/b] branch you can find cloth there.

Please give this a try and send any feedback that you may encounter our way. Don't hesitate to let us know everything: from bugs and aspects that are unintuitive to the things you love from this version so we know not to mess with them! 
Write to us here on the discussions or on any of our Social Media platforms. We'll try to engage as much as possible. And one thing, if you like this update, please let others know so in the reviews! Help us spread the word that Kodon is growing! 

Have a great week everyone! 

Brianda <3

notes.title: What we're working on...
notes.content:
[b]Hi friends![/b]

I wanted to hop over here since it has been a little while since the last update and we want to let you know what's going on. 
[list]
[*] Kodon is going through a phase of UI/UX fixes. We hope to have better menus as well as an overall smoother user experience. 
[*] We're working hard on performance, trying to improve the resource consumption and give you a higher polycount on your sculpts without compromising on fps. 
[*] We're also slowly but surely scratching out the bugs that still persist: Conversion and Remesh, as well as other smaller ones. 
[/list]
All of this is aimed at improving the workflow, UX, and generally give you guys a pleasant feeling when working in Kodon. 

[b]... oh, and Multiresolution is also coming soon ;) [/b]

You will be hearing from me as I bring you the updates in the next few weeks. 
I hope everyone's had a nice Easter holiday! Thanks for the support!

[b]Brianda <3 [/b]

notes.title: Trigger issue fix and improved Remesh interface
notes.content:
Hey there everyone!

It's Brianda again with another update. Here's what you can expect: 

[list]
[*] [b]Trigger issue fixed:[/b] We have looked into the issue that some of you have reported and we have implemented a fix, please let us know if you're still experiencing any problems.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Remesh poly count prediction:[/b] You are now able to set an amount of polys you desire to obtain from performing a remesh and you will get a good approximation to it as a result. Let us know how this is working for you.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Easier load of reference images:[/b] You can now load reference images from the native windows file explorer in desktop mode. The reference images do now show up in the outliner in VR, where you can hide and delete them.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Undo bug fixes and Improved menus:[/b] Some improvements can be found in these areas. Let us know if the changes have helped on your general workflow.

You will find some of the different settings are only available in desktop for the time being, usually advanced settings, this is not the way they are meant to stay. 
Have a look on both interfaces and don't hesitate to try out your tablet with Kodon. Our tablet support is up and working. We're very interested in hearing your thoughts about this functionality and what would make it better.

notes.title: New patch is out!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

Kodon's new patch is out and this is a little update of what you can expect when it comes to new features and changes, as well as bugs that remain and we're still working on.

[b]Main features:[/b]

[list]
[*] [i]Lock light:[/i] allows you to have the light attached to your head so it is always facing your object as you work on it (It can be disabled).

[*] [i]Voxel noise and surface trace:[/i] New abilities to manipulate voxels.

[*] [i]Faceted wireframe sculpting:[/i] A more informative and clear view of what happens during sculpting.

[*] [i]PBR Materials/surface:[/i] More realistic and informative materials and reflections. 

[*] Undo: Some of the problems with this have been ironed out. 
[/list]


[b]Main Bugs:[/b]

[list]
[*] [i]Undo[/i] still has some persisting issues

[*] [i]Remesher[/i] still needs some work. It can sometimes be triggered by accidentally accessing it with the radial menu (this can cause some unexpected lagging), it can also cause spikes and disappearing mesh. 

[*] [i]Model Room [/i] still needs more work

[*] [i]Poly count[/i] in the sculpt room can struggle a bit if the number is too high. 

[*] Imprecise sliders in VR. 
[/list]

We're still trying to fix all the bugs as fast as we can, but sometimes things get broken in the process of fixing others. No worries though, we're on top of it and with your feedback trying out the newest patches we will get there! 

Let us know what you think, problems you encounter and things that you would like stayed the same. 

Brianda :)

notes.title: We need beta testers
notes.content:
[b]Hi Kodon enthusiasts![/b]

We are now finally able to give you an update on the future of Kodon.

The release of the next Beta version is very close. We have done internal testing and a lot of tweaking. Kodon is getting more robust and we want to improve as much as possible on all parts of the program. 

This is where you can help!

We have decided to implement a focus beta signup that you can be a part of to test Kodon and give us feedback on the state of the program. This way we can make more specific changes and improve the program further. 

[b]Our timeline now:[/b]

1. [b]Beta signups[/b] - short phase. Participants here will be included in a special pool of users, where we will pick core testers.
2. [b]Closed Beta[/b] - Users in the closed beta get access to an advanced build, including coming features.
3. [b]Open Beta[/b] - the open beta is first released to sign up users, then to everyone.
4. [b]Release[/b] - release of the final Beta version (the last step before full release).

There is a form [url=https://www.tenklabs.com/kodon-beta-signup-fix]here[/url] that you can use to sign up as a registered beta tester. 
We will be in constant communication with the Core testers, and they will get updates as to how their feedback is impacting the version through live chatting with the developers of Kodon. 

Help us make the perfect program!

notes.title: Kodon v0.55 full version is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/c930a414f9d4489b77353da684819e716e8238ed.png[/img]

[i]NOTE: v0.55 in Kodon, an Early Access product, means in our terms we are about 55% done, expected v1.0 later this year. Each build should be seen as a "prealpha" for now. Thanks for your patience and support![/i]

Change/Feature List:

[list]
[*] [b]Undo/Redo[/b]
Fixed the undo/redo issues and crashes.
[*] [b]New Undo History Slider[/b]
We added a new undo history slider that allows you to quickly scroll through your sculpting timeline.
[*] [b]Menu rework[/b]
[*] [b]New Voxel Save option[/b]
You can now save your voxelspace creations and load / keep working on them.
[*] [b]New Environment ("InfGrid").[/b]
Simplistic optimized environment with an infinite floor and a neutral skybox.
[*] [b]Ambient Occlusion.[/b]
Simple AO-effect that you can turn on off. PS: a little slow and unoptimized in this iteration.
[*] [b]Voxel Engine Speed[/b]
We have reworked the voxel engine in order to improve draw speed, and you should notice a considerably smoother sculpting experience via the standard tools.
[*] [b]Voxel Engine Capacity[/b]
We’ve also reworked the algorithm to increase the amount of voxels you can work with. At this point you are, in terms of detail, only limited by your memory and GPU.
[*] [b]Memory and Optimization[/b]
We have reduced the memory footprint drastically with this version allowing you to draw massive models even with just 16GB of ram. And with a 1080 Ti we are reaching 10 million triangles before any “VR-breaking” slowdown.
[*] [b]New: Improved Square Voxel Brush[/b]
We changed the Square brush, it is now able to rotate with your tool.

Known issues:

[list]
[*] At 8Gb setups, you can bottom out your RAM usage, possibly forcing a restart.
[*] Short lags will occur for some cases of memory allocation (when you have sculpted for a long while).
[*] There are occasional issues with .obj and ply import. The voxel save should be pretty safe.
[*] Some occasional artifacts (small dots and normal lines) on the models visible at low zoom levels.
[/list]

Please report bugs and suggestions in the Steam forums. We will respond and give you tips to fix any issues, and all bug reports and suggestions are very useful to us!

notes.title: v0.50 soon! Meanwhile, try some of it in [beta]
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/3c57a8c76c5ad5da60e2a97eaef8a460df0108f4.png[/img]
[i]We've thought long and hard on this version. The brain model took about 2 minutes to put together with the new crease and move tools[/i]

v0.50 will be the version marking roughly halfway (50%) finished development of Kodon. This version will include a lot of the technology gained from the Royal Academy of Arts exhibition work (you know.. the delay where we went silent for over a month), as well as new changes suggested by our pro sculptor Emil to bring Kodon more in directon of existing sculpting software (like ZBrush).

Furthermore, several bugfixes are in, including (as it seems) finally having returned Win7 support to Kodon! (removing the "freeze" problem) Also, the "white flashes" (framedrops returning you to the SteamVR lobby) have been minimized.

You can go to the [beta] branch (rightclick Kodon in Steam, Properties, choose the BETAS-tab and choose "beta -" in the pulldown menu. Ignore the "code" field) and check out some of the upcoming features:

* 1.5 million polygon limit per object (unlimited in principle, but current version is RAM heavy - will fix when optimized)
* Move-tool (also known as "grab" in other programs)
* Fold-tool (also known as "crease" in other programs)
* Falloff-control on all tools
* Full vertex paint in all modes

More is obviously coming with the "actual" v0.50 (in 1-2 weeks from this announcement) - a new default environment, new tools, UX improvements and heavy optimizations.

notes.title: Apologies - RA Exhibition done!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/929cd63d39e047561231752f0a7255d3641d047d.jpg[/img]

Apologies for the lack of updates lately! We've been working like dogs on getting Kodon ready for the Royal Academy of Arts' exhibition "Virtually Real".

Everything went very well with the exhibition, with visits from several people from HTC, UK Minister of State for Culture, Communications and Creative Industries Matt Hancock ( https://twitter.com/MattHancockMP/status/818533025420103682 ), event arranger Eddie Walker and of course our brilliant artists, Adham, Jessy, and Elliott.

The exhibition concept was sculpting objects in virtual reality, printing them out to a scale of about 1 ton in weight, and arranging an interactive VR exhibition of the same objects.

What's in it for Kodon supporters:

* Separate "interactive exhibition mode" which can be used for exhibiting your objects with a limited interactive scope.
* OBJ and PLY file loading times optimized 10x
* Support for megaobjects
* Vastly improved vertex spray paint algorithm.

The changes can be observed (with some help) in the exhibition/exhibition2/exhibition3 branches. However it might be better to wait for us to roll it out into the main branch.

Again, apologies for the lack of updates! We'll make it up to you!

notes.title: On postponations & silence + some info on the coming update
notes.content:
We have had some challenges with the algorithms and UX in the patch we are working on (non-stop..), this has caused some long weeks of just coding.

It really sucks not to have time to give updates, but we want to give proper answers to people, and when you have your head chock full of advanced algorithms that are not working properly, that is a bit tricky.

Our community contact was supposed to be the fix for that - she has been hindered from starting her work, but luckily, she is in place today!


What is coming:

1) A new approach to polygon mapping that gives you unlimited polygons to work with. (100% done)
2) A new and clever solution to making geometric-like shapes, and make rough sculpting easier. (70% done - here is an early screenshot with edge bugs - don't judge! http://imgur.com/a/vX5ID )
3) A new approach to mirroring that includes radial symmetry (30% done)
4) Saving, undo etc for the new functionality (0% done)

Most of the work is in point 1) and 2) All in all, the version is about 70% done. There will be some hefty work in the coming time. Our new ETA looks like next week.

notes.title: Kodon Early Access v0.35 - optimization + "cut" tool + autosmooth
notes.content:
Some bugfixes and some new features from our main codebranch. Most important are the autosmooth and "cut"-tool.

"Autosmooth":

Autosmooth will let you set an angle - every detail sharper than this angle will be slowly cut away when you release the trigger. This can be used to reduce coarse detail, to create certain organic textures from noise, or to round off shapes.

Autosmooth has been wrapped with "autojoin" into a feature called "auto-reduce" which can be turned on and off.

The cut tool:

"Cut" works by slicing away everything above the cutting surface. This tool has replaced the "flatten" tool in the tool cycle, and is a potent rough sculpting tool until the upcoming features are out.

Still some beta issues here, so get ready to "undo". ;)

Important change: Both "cut" and "flatten" will now lock to the plane you start drawing at, allowing you to easily create completely flat details.

Another important change is that neither cut, flatten nor smoothen will now subdivide (since their goal is a flattened surface) - this will save you a lot of polys.

Other changes:
* A new, symmetric "egg" shape for head designs
* Indicator for maximum polygons
* "Call menu" will now reset the menu, the sculpting object and the light in a fixed spot around you.
* Some menu redesign
* Various bugfixes and optimizations (among other for "Redo")

notes.title: Kodon Early Access v0.35 - optimization + "cut" tool + autosmooth
notes.content:
Some bugfixes and some new features from our main codebranch. Most important are the autosmooth and "cut"-tool.

"Autosmooth":

Autosmooth will let you set an angle - every detail sharper than this angle will be slowly cut away when you release the trigger. This can be used to reduce coarse detail, to create certain organic textures from noise, or to round off shapes.

Autosmooth has been wrapped with "autojoin" into a feature called "auto-reduce" which can be turned on and off.

The cut tool:

"Cut" works by slicing away everything above the cutting surface. This tool has replaced the "flatten" tool in the tool cycle, and is a potent rough sculpting tool until the upcoming features are out.

Still some beta issues here, so get ready to "undo". ;)

Important change: Both "cut" and "flatten" will now lock to the plane you start drawing at, allowing you to easily create completely flat details.

Another important change is that neither cut, flatten nor smoothen will now subdivide (since their goal is a flattened surface) - this will save you a lot of polys.

Other changes:
* A new, symmetric "egg" shape for head designs
* Indicator for maximum polygons
* "Call menu" will now reset the menu, the sculpting object and the light in a fixed spot around you.
* Some menu redesign
* Various bugfixes and optimizations (among other for "Redo")

notes.title: Kodon Early Access v0.3 - major optimizations
notes.content:
This update brings a completely new sculpting algorithm, and a new mirror, with a combination of GPU, multicore CPU and other optimizations. Please go to Kodon -> Options and see if you can run a higher quality setting (restart to take effect)

Why the lag in v0.2, and why the delay?

To put it short, we had a HUGE issue with a combination of SteamVR, Unity and the new optimization techniques, stepping all over each others territory. It was a problem nobody at Valve or Unity really appeared to could help us with, which made it really stressful.

We've been at it really hard for the last weeks, the plan (as some of you might remember) was to introduce new techniques for rough sculpting, but unfortunately the lag issues people were experiencing drove us to upgrade the sculpting algorithm first.

So to put it short, this update:

* Was a lot of work...!
* Delayed some of our promises
* Contains a huge upgrade of the sculpting algorithm, which increases precision and quality in pretty much everything. The "Max" category should now be within reach of many of you.
* Using GPU and multicore in all complex operations should fix most lag situations.

Would love to know about any bugs or remaining lag issues, or to which degree this update fixed Kodon for you.

Stay tuned for the rough shaping algorithm / shape synth coming up soon!
